*.q: scattering vector q (Å⁻¹), the x axis
*.qNm: scattering vector q (nm⁻¹), the x axis
*.sigma: standard error of the measured intensity
*.parameter: the fitted quantity this row is about

run.section: the part of the run this row belongs to
run.name: the setting or statistic of the run
run.unit: its unit, empty for a pure number

runRows.nAtoms: atoms in the model, hydrogens included
runRows.pmvFallbackUncert: uncertainty given to a solute that has none
runRows.lmaxPinned: 1 if lmax was set by hand, not from q
runRows.c1Kink: 1 if c1 was sampled (kink), 0 if profiled
runRows.memoryHeadroom: % of RAM kept free in the scattering build
runRows.forwardBlocks: q blocks of the scattering build
runRows.forwardBlockQ: q values per block of the build
runRows.forwardEstGib: estimated memory of one block, GiB
runRows.forwardPeakGib: peak resident memory after the build, GiB
runRows.addHydrogens: 0 if the pipeline added no hydrogens
runRows.structureModel: model used of a multi-model structure
runRows.qMin: lowest q of the fitted range
runRows.qMax: highest q of the fitted range
runRows.sigmaScale: factor the measured errors were scaled by
runRows.nQInput: measured points given, before any cut
runRows.nQCropped: points outside qMin to qMax, left out
runRows.nQExcluded: points in an excluded q range, left out
runRows.cavityFrac: share of the hydration shell that is cavity
runRows.exclVolSat: c1 at its bound: 1 upper, -1 lower, 0 none
runRows.stepSize: median NUTS step size over chains
runRows.stepSizeMin: smallest NUTS step size of any chain
runRows.channels: Shannon channels in the measured q range
runRows.rebinMeasured: measured points that went into the bins
runRows.rebinNonPositiveDropped: bins dropped for a non-positive intensity
runRows.nSamples: NUTS iterations per chain, warm-up included
runRows.rngSeed: random seed that reproduces the run
runRows.iterations: posterior draws pooled from the used chains
runRows.treeDepthAvg: mean depth of the NUTS trees
runRows.treeDepthMax: deepest NUTS tree; at the limit is poor
runRows.ebfmi: worst chain's E-BFMI; below 0.3 is poor
runRows.divergenceRate: share of divergent draws; above 0.01 is poor
runRows.rhatMax: worst split R-hat; above 1.01 is unconverged
runRows.modes: posterior modes the chains settled in
runRows.optima: local optima that carry posterior mass
runRows.rewhitenedNats: gain of a basin better than the MAP search
runRows.retryFirstRhat: worst R-hat of the first, repeated run
runRows.retryKept: 1 if the repeated run's draws were kept
runRows.retryCount: sampler runs after the first one
runRows.attemptNAdapt: warm-up iterations given to run k
runRows.attemptNDraws: post-warm-up iterations given to run k
runRows.attemptRhat: worst split R-hat at the end of run k
runRows.attemptEss: smallest effective sample size of run k
runRows.attemptDivergent: share of divergent draws of run k
runRows.drawsRows: rows of the draws sheet, one per draw
runRows.quantileLoPct: lower percentile of the quantiles interval
runRows.quantileHiPct: upper percentile of the quantiles interval

parameterRows.logDensity: log posterior density at the draw (nats)
parameterRows.rhoE: electron density of the bulk solvent (e⁻/Å³)
parameterRows.deltaRho1: contrast of the first water bead type (δρ₁)
parameterRows.deltaRho2: contrast of the second water bead type (δρ₂)
parameterRows.scale: intensity scale between model and data
parameterRows.chi2: reduced χ² of the fit to the data

map.value: its value at the MAP (most probable) draw

quantiles.quantileLo: lower end of the credible interval
quantiles.quantileHi: upper end of the credible interval

stdevFromPrior.parameter: a parameter that has a prior
stdevFromPrior.zMap: MAP distance from the prior mean, in SDs
stdevFromPrior.zQuantileLo: interval's lower end from the mean, in SDs
stdevFromPrior.zQuantileHi: interval's upper end from the mean, in SDs

modes.share: this mode's share of the posterior mass
modes.logMass: bridge-sampling log mass of the mode (nats)
modes.logMassErr: bridge-sampling error of the log mass (nats)
modes.chains: number of chains that settled in this mode
modes.kept: 1 if its draws are kept, 0 if negligible

optima.optimum: number of the optimum of the MAP search
optima.share: its share of the Laplace mass
optima.chains: number of chains that ended at this optimum
optima.started: number of those chains that started there

formFactorLog.line: one line of the form-factor log

data.sigma: standard error of the measured intensity

model.I_map: model intensity of the MAP draw (a.u.)
model.quantileLo: lower credible-interval curve of the model
model.quantileHi: upper credible-interval curve of the model
model.boundLo: lowest model curve inside the interval
model.boundHi: highest model curve inside the interval

residuals.sigma: standard error of the measured intensity
residuals.I_map: model intensity of the MAP draw

hist.binLo: lower edge of the histogram bin
hist.binHi: upper edge of the histogram bin
hist.count: number of draws that fall in the bin

draws.chain: number of the chain the draw came from
draws.draw: position of the draw within its chain
draws.deltaRho1 (0.03 e-/A^3): contrast δρ₁ of the first hydration shell
draws.deltaRho2 (0.03 e-/A^3): contrast δρ₂ of the second hydration shell
draws.deltaRho3 (0.03 e-/A^3): contrast δρ₃ of the third hydration shell
draws.scale: intensity scale factor of the draw
draws.exclVolCorr (c1): excluded-volume correction c1 of the draw
draws.chi2FitGrid: reduced χ² of the draw on the fitted q grid
draws.logDensity: log posterior density of the draw
draws.treeDepth: depth of the sampler's trajectory tree
draws.nSteps: number of leapfrog steps of the trajectory
draws.acceptanceRate: sampler acceptance rate of the draw

compare.sigma (a.u.): standard error of the measured intensity
compare.fit_*: MAP curve of that model on the measured q
compare.ref_*: reference curve on the measured q
